recommendation: Keep the fix as-is. It resolves the remaining FHIR-32408 ambiguity without changing the data model or adding unrelated Device boundary guidance.
issue_request: FHIR-32408 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for R5. It reported that DeviceMetric was listed as a Device-related resource even though Device has no reference to DeviceMetric, and the OO resolution asked to state that the relationship is established through DeviceMetric rather than Device and to add the reverse DeviceMetric boundary wording.
initial_application: The accepted Device Scope-Boundary-Relationships package was applied in commit 3c23148747 (apply #20574), which listed FHIR-32408 with FHIR-32382, FHIR-32277, FHIR-32276, and FHIR-32681. That commit added Device/DeviceMetric boundary text, but the Device entry still described Device as having multiple metrics without making the reference direction explicit.
additional_context: Device and DeviceMetric are active resources in source/fhir.ini. The authoritative DeviceMetric structure definition defines DeviceMetric.device as a required Reference(Device). The 2022-06-13 OO HCP minutes record a 10-0-0 motion to accept Device Scope-Boundary-Relationships and disposition FHIR-32408 through that document. Targeted Zulip searches found no conflicting community discussion.
reconciliation: Updated source/device/device-introduction.xml to say a Device may be associated with multiple metrics through each DeviceMetric.device reference rather than by a Device reference, and updated source/devicemetric/devicemetric-introduction.xml to state the reverse relationship from the DeviceMetric boundary list item.
source_changes: source/device/device-introduction.xml: clarified that DeviceMetric associations point from DeviceMetric to Device through DeviceMetric.device rather than from Device to DeviceMetric.
source/devicemetric/devicemetric-introduction.xml: added the reverse boundary statement that DeviceMetric.device establishes the relationship and Device does not reference DeviceMetric.
